title: Isolation of total RNA from Synechocystis (PGTX method)
author: Anna Behle
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.jm3ck8n

steps.title: Harvest cyanobacterial culture
steps.instruction: Fill a 50 mL tube with ice, add ~25 mL cyanobacterial culture grown to OD₇₅₀ ≈ 1 until the tube is full, then centrifuge 5 min at maximum speed.

steps.title: Wash pellet and transfer
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant, resuspend the pellet in the remaining ~1 mL water, transfer the suspension to a fresh 2 mL tube, and centrifuge 1 min at maximum speed.

steps.title: Resuspend in PGTX and freeze
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 1 mL PGTX solution (phenol‑containing; wear gloves and other PPE), flash‑freeze, and store at –80 °C for later extraction or proceed immediately.

steps.title: Heat‑induced lysis
steps.instruction: Heat the samples at 95 °C in a shaking heat block for 5 min, vortexing intermittently to ensure complete lysis.

steps.title: Cool on ice
steps.instruction: Place the heated samples on ice for 5 min.

steps.title: First chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Add 700 µL chloroform/IAA to each sample, mix well, incubate at room temperature for 10 min while vortexing intermittently (wear appropriate PPE), then centrifuge at maximum speed for 10 min. Transfer the aqueous phase to a fresh tube.

steps.title: Second chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Add 1 volume chloroform/IAA, vortex to mix, centrifuge 10 min at maximum speed, and transfer the aqueous phase to a fresh tube (wear appropriate PPE).

steps.title: Ethanol precipitation
steps.instruction: Add 3 volumes of 100 % ethanol containing sodium acetate at a 10:1 ethanol:NaOAc ratio, mix well, and precipitate the RNA for 1 h at –80 °C or overnight at –20 °C.

steps.title: Pellet collection
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the precipitated sample at 4 °C, maximum speed, for at least 30 min; carefully remove the supernatant without disturbing the RNA pellet.

steps.title: Wash and resuspend RNA
steps.instruction: Wash the pellet with 70 % ethanol, centrifuge 15 min at 4 °C, maximum speed, remove all supernatant, dry the pellet at room temperature for ~5 min (do not overdry), and finally resuspend in 40 µL RNase‑free water.
